cfg.alerts.backup_kwh.help: Once per day. The backup heater turns electricity into heat 1:1 – about three times as expensive as the heat pump. 0 = never report.
cfg.alerts.device_minutes.help: How long a device may stay silent before it is reported.
cfg.alerts.dhw_low_temp.help: Reported when the tank stays colder for 30 minutes.
cfg.alerts.push_url.help: ntfy topic, e.g. https://ntfy.sh/a-long-secret-word (“ntfy” app on the phone, subscribe to the same topic). Empty = alerts only here on the page.
cfg.dhw.apply.help: Off = test mode: decisions are only shown.
cfg.dhw.bath_temp.help: Target when a bath is requested.
cfg.dhw.battery_first.help: Reheat with PV only while exporting or when the battery will surely be full today.
cfg.dhw.boost_temp.help: Only when little sun is coming tomorrow, the battery gets full and the house is warm.
cfg.dhw.dhw_power_w: Electric power in hot water mode
cfg.dhw.dull_night_min: Let it cool before a dull day
cfg.dhw.dull_night_min.help: At night before a dull day, let the tank drop to the minimum temperature – it is reheated during the day instead of at night from battery or grid.
cfg.dhw.enabled.help: Keeps working out the best hot water temperature.
cfg.dhw.hygiene_enabled.help: Once per interval, heat the tank to the protection temperature – preferably with PV.
cfg.dhw.hygiene_max_days.help: If there was no PV day for that long, it heats at midday (11–15 h) anyway.
cfg.dhw.hygiene_max_min.help: If the tank doesn't reach the temperature within this time, the attempt counts as finished.
cfg.dhw.min_temp.help: Lower limit while waiting for the sun.
cfg.dhw.power_control: Adapt hot water power to PV
cfg.dhw.power_control.help: While heating with PV: less power when the surplus is small, more while exporting (ISG “WW-Leistung”, via the ISG web page).
cfg.dhw.power_every_min: Change hot water power at most every
cfg.dhw.power_high: Hot water power with lots of PV
cfg.dhw.power_low: Hot water power with little PV
cfg.dhw.power_max_writes: Hot water power: max. changes per day
cfg.dhw.pv_only: Above the minimum only with PV
cfg.dhw.pv_only.help: Above the minimum temperature only PV surplus heats; otherwise the heat pump just holds the minimum. A requested bath is always heated. Off = otherwise comfort temperature.
cfg.dhw.solar_wait.help: Hold the minimum temperature before sunny hours.
cfg.dhw.start_surplus_ratio: Start threshold (share of hot water power)
cfg.dhw.stop_deficit_w: Stop when drawing from grid/battery above
cfg.economy.cop_dhw.help: Otherwise calculated from the heat pump's counters.
cfg.economy.cop_heating.help: Otherwise calculated from the heat pump's counters.
cfg.error.choice: {label}: {value} is not one of the options
cfg.heating.apply.help: Off = test mode: decisions are only shown.
cfg.heating.battery_fill_safety.help: The forecast must cover the battery's need this many times before the house gets priority.
cfg.heating.battery_first.help: During the day the battery fills first. As long as it won't make it today, no preheating – the house stays at the normal room temperature.
cfg.heating.dhw_first.help: Off = winter order: house first, then hot water (only a bath always has priority).
cfg.heating.enabled.help: In winter, store PV surplus as heat in the house.
cfg.heating.house_kwh_per_k.help: An estimate; sets how much PV a full buffer needs.
cfg.heating.lower_deficit_w: Lower when drawing from grid/battery above
cfg.heating.mode_min_min.help: Normal, setback and “battery first” switch at the earliest after this time – no jumps with clouds or a wobbling forecast.
cfg.heating.normal_temp.help: What you normally want (room temp. day HC1).
cfg.heating.outside_max.help: Only when it is colder outside.
cfg.heating.poor_day_kwh.help: Then no setback – no sun is coming.
cfg.heating.room_from_isg: Room temperature from the heat pump
cfg.heating.room_from_isg.help: Only with a Stiebel room control unit (FET). Without it the heat pump only echoes its room setpoint.
cfg.heating.room_max.help: PV may heat the house up to here – the more sun is still coming, the higher.
cfg.heating.room_min.help: Evenings/nights when sun is coming: it may cool down to here before the heat pump heats.
cfg.heating.room_sensor_max_age_min.help: How long the room sensor's last reading counts. The sensor reports to /api/sensor/room?t=…&h=… (Shelly H&T: webhook, see README). Without a valid value PV heats up to the buffer target, without the “buffer full” check.
cfg.heating.start_offset_k.help: The first target is just above the room temperature – the compressor ramps up slowly.
cfg.heating.step_k.help: Small steps = fine power: the inverter heat pump modulates with the gap between target and room.
cfg.heating.stop_deficit_w: Stop when drawing from grid/battery above
cfg.ui.language.help: Language of the pages, decisions, alerts and push messages. Stored logs keep their language.

web.explain.absenkung_waerme_vom_vortag: Setback – heat from the day before
web.explain.aendern_unter_pv_regelung_je: Change under “PV control”. Each control writes at most every 10–15 min and is limited per day; when switched off, the normal value is written back.
web.explain.aus_den_zaehlern_der_waermep: From the heat pump's counters – that's why the house comes first in winter.
web.explain.bis_dahin_geht_die_batterie_: Until then the battery comes first; the house only preheats when the battery will surely be full today.
web.explain.danach_das_warmwasser_tagesb: Then the hot water: daily need with PV, a reserve only before a dull day.
web.explain.darum_gibt_es_keinen_55_c: That's why there is no 55 °C boost any more: hot water above the need has the worst COP and only pays off before a dull day.
web.explain.die_erste_entscheidung_folgt: The first decision follows within a minute.
web.explain.die_rechnung_was_eine_kwh_so: The maths: what a kWh of solar power is worth
web.explain.dieselben_regeln_wie_unter_s: The same rules as under “How it works”, simulated minute by minute against a simple model of the house
web.explain.entscheidet_ueber_vorrat_und: Decides on the reserve and the setback.
web.explain.gemessen_cop_je_k_h_heizen: measured: {eco} COP per K, {eco2} h of heating at
web.explain.gespeicherte_waerme_zaehlt_a: Stored heat only counts if it is needed before the next sun – otherwise it just pushes out tomorrow's free power.
web.explain.im_winter_heizt_die_regelung: In winter the control still preheats the house first – by far the most fits in there (several kWh of electricity per day instead of ~1 kWh of hot water).
web.explain.im_winter_ist_das_haus_selbs: In winter the house itself is the best store: screed and floor slab take the heat at a COP of ~4.6, and a KfW 40+ house loses only about 1–1.5 K overnight.
web.explain.jede_kwh_die_eine_spaetere_k: So every kWh that replaces a later kWh from the grid or the battery is worth almost four times as much as feeding it in.
web.explain.jede_minute_zuerst_soll_das_: Every minute, first: should the house be preheated with PV – or may it cool down a little without PV?
web.explain.kfw_40_20_kwh_k_speicher: (KfW 40+, 20 kWh/K storage), hot water tank, battery and PV – compared with fixed values
web.explain.komfortband_der_fussbodenhei: Comfort band of the floor heating; buffer depending on the sun.
web.explain.lwz_5_s_plus_datenblatt_kurv: (LWZ 5 S Plus: datasheet curve × {eco} from its own counters) · hot water {eco2} ·

web.explain.raum_normal_warmwasser_komfo: (room normal, hot water comfort). Cost per day: grid import × electricity price − feed-in × tariff. Model values, not measurements.
web.explain.schematisch_linie_ziel_der_r: Schematic: line = the control's target, area = PV generation. The battery is kept for household appliances in the evening.
web.explain.tagesbedarf_mittags_mit_pv_k: Daily need at midday with PV, no overheating
web.explain.vorheizen_nur_bei_sonne_nach: Preheat only in sunshine, at night the stored heat carries
web.explain.vorrat_nur_vor_einem_trueben: Reserve only before a dull day.
web.explain.warmwasser_minimum_tagesbeda: Hot water minimum / daily need / reserve
web.explain.was_das_in_euro_bringt_zeigt: What that is worth in euros is shown on the “Finance” tab. Places 2–4 are almost level: they move heat or power that is needed anyway into the sunny hours.
web.explain.wintertag_raumziel_hk1_fussb: Winter day: room target HC1 (floor heating)
web.finance.einspeiseerloes_und_netzkost: Feed-in income and grid cost per day

web.finance.noch_keine_tage_erfasst_der_: No days recorded yet – the first day appears today.
web.finance.vorteil_durch_pv_was_haus_un: “Benefit from PV” = what house and car would have cost without PV (all at the import price) plus the balance.

web.flow.energiefluss_zwischen_netz: Energy flow between grid, inverter, battery, charge point and house

web.forms.nur_auf_der_geraeteseite_einst: Only adjustable on the device's own page
web.forms.wird_von_der_pv_warmwasserrege: Controlled by the PV hot water control – set the comfort temperature there.
web.html.intro_before: The control uses the hot water tank as a heat battery: with PV surplus it is heated, before sunny hours it waits for the sun, so the house battery isn't drained for hot water.

web.html.warnungen_und_fehler_des_dienst: Warnings and errors of the service, plus restarts, devices answering again and resolved alerts. The same message within 10 minutes is grouped. Stored in the database on the server, for 90 days.

web.overview.danach_gilt_wieder_die_norm: After that the normal hot water rule applies again.
web.overview.erste_entscheidung_folgt_in: The first decision follows within a minute.
